# Verdance Systems AI

> Verdance Systems AI is an AI systems agency. We design, build and run AI
> systems for businesses across four pillars: Marketing, Sales, Internal
> Operations and Automations. Clients own everything we build: every account,
> agent and automation is registered in their name from day one. Engagements
> start with a free 30 minute audit call that produces a
> prioritised roadmap and a fixed quote.

Founded and led by Daniel Bouwer. Website: https://verdancesystemsai.com
Contact: daniel@verdancesystemsai.com · WhatsApp: +27 73 996 1535

## What we build

### Marketing
- Lead generation: database reactivation, lead finding and scraping, landing
  pages, funnels, forms, surveys and QR capture
- Reputation: Google review automation that requests a review after every sale
- Websites and custom apps: fast, search-ready builds with lead capture built in
- Social and content systems

### Sales
- Conversation AI: AI agents answering WhatsApp, SMS, website chat, Instagram,
  Facebook Messenger, TikTok and LinkedIn messages in seconds, around the clock
- Voice AI: inbound and outbound voice agents, AI receptionists, call routing
  and tracking
- Booking: smart scheduling synced to calendars with no back-and-forth
- Follow-up and nurture: multi-touch automated follow-up on every lead

### Internal Operations
- Customised CRM and pipeline setup, lead scoring and routing
- Payments and invoicing automation, including automatic invoice chasing
- Tracking dashboards, analytics and reporting

### Automations
- Custom AI agents built for business-specific workflows
- MCP server integrations connecting business tools to AI safely
- Client intake automation and workflow automation between tools

## How engagements work

1. Audit (week 0): a free 30 minute call producing a plan, in priority order
2. Blueprint (week 1): exact system specification with a fixed quote
3. Build (weeks 2-3): systems assembled and tested
4. Integrate: wired into the client's CRM, calendar, phone lines and channels
5. Launch: a go-live date written into the contract
6. Run and optimise: ongoing monitoring, tuning and monthly reporting

## Commercial terms

- Fixed quote agreed in writing before any work begins
- A launch date in the contract
- Full ownership: accounts, agents and automations in the client's name from day one

## Where we work

Remote-first. Nothing is installed and nobody has to visit the client: every
engagement is set up on a video call and runs on the client's own accounts.

South Africa: Johannesburg, Pretoria, Sandton, Centurion, Midrand, Cape Town,
Stellenbosch, George, Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Gqeberha, Bloemfontein,
Polokwane, Mbombela, Rustenburg.

United Kingdom: London, Manchester, Birmingham.

## Free tools

Missed call calculator: https://verdancesystemsai.com/missed-call-calculator
Works out what unanswered calls and messages cost a business per year, from
three inputs: contacts missed per week, average customer value, and close rate.
The formula is missed per week x customer value x close rate x 52. A business
missing 15 contacts a week worth R4 000 each, winning 30 percent of them, is
losing about R936 000 a year. No sign-up, works in Rand and Pounds.
